issues.summary: Rename this parameter to "inputs" to match the naming used by the other foreach functions.
Make the `value` argument keyword-only for all these foreach functions, including the ones at lines 1288 and 1601.
The overloads with and without alpha resolve the Scalar overload differently and may behave oddly; either document this or always pass alpha=1 so the preferred overload is used.
The claim that maximum/minimum always dispatch to clamp may be wrong because there are specialized kernels; check it and remove it if it isn't true.
In-place variants are missing from the overrides list; asks why they aren't included.
test/test_meta.py has the same logic at the top and should be changed to reuse this new helper.
If func() is in-place, it has already run before the argument error is raised, so the warning or error should say the function was actually executed.
Asks why there is an empty return here.
The signature bind may be expensive; benchmark its overhead on an optimizer use case.
Changing this docs anchor may break existing external links to it.
